messages:
rachel: Submitted a small PR to clarify SOC2/retention language and add a point-in-time export example + a short migration hint. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/671
jon: skimmed it. nice and concise. two asks: 1) clarify that tenant-level TTL is the default and routes can have shorter overrides; 2) explicitly state that snapshot exports do not prolong or alter scheduled deletions. auditors asked for explicitness.
rachel: updated wording: 'Each tenant has a configured default retention TTL. Individual audit routes may specify shorter retention overrides. Snapshot exports capture data at request time and do not change scheduled deletions.' added a one-line migration hint mapping old_event.user -> actor.id and note to preserve legacy event_id for traceability.
pm-legal: wording is fine. please use 'indefinite' instead of 'permanent' where applicable and add a short legal-hold lifecycle line: 'When Legal places a hold, scheduled deletions are suspended until Legal releases the hold; release actions are recorded.' also include the internal retention policy pointer: https://internal/legal/retention-policy for auditors.
rachel: switched to 'indefinite', added the internal link, and included a tiny curl export example showing the --redact flag and role requirement: `curl -X POST /api/v1/audit/export -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","start":"2024-01-01","end":"2024-01-31","redact":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' # requires OrganizationAdmin or Compliance role`
jon: nit: show expected error when redaction not enabled (customers care about failure modes).
rachel: added expected 409 example in the docs: `{"error":"redaction_not_configured","message":"PII redaction not enabled for tenant"}`. fixed broken anchor in CLI docs to /docs/cli#audit-export.
docs-ci: PR 671 updated, link-check passed, build green.
rachel: planning to merge tomorrow morning if no objections. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
